summary: A drop-in OpenAI Agents SDK Tool that lets any OpenAI agent pay an x402-priced HTTP endpoint in Nano (XNO) from a self-custodied wallet, reusing the existing Nano x402 rail (feeless402 client + x402nano-exact dialect) instead of rebuilding any payment logic.

target.audience: developers building agents with the OpenAI Agents SDK that consume paid HTTP APIs
target.why_missing: The OpenAI Agents SDK's only x402 payment integration, AsterPay, settles in USDC (EVM/Base) only. There is no Nano (XNO) x402 payer or tool for the OpenAI Agents SDK anywhere: OpenAI has an MCP client pay-for-tools flow on EVM USDC, Cloudflare Agents SDK pays EVM USDC, paygraph and x402-agent cover LangGraph/CrewAI with USDC. None speak the Nano x402 dialect. Search for an existing openai-agents Nano adapter (PyPI and GitHub) returns nothing.

novelty: No Nano (XNO) x402 Tool exists for the OpenAI Agents SDK anywhere (verified: no PyPI package openai-agents-nano, agents-nano-x402, x402-nano-agents; every framework x402 payer AsterPay, Cloudflare, paygraph, x402-langchain, AgentSwarm is USDC/EVM-only). This is a thin adapter: it wraps the existing MIT-licensed feeless402 self-custodied Nano client (Wallet + RPC + request_with_payment) as an OpenAI Agents SDK Tool, so OpenAI agents gain a fee-free, instant, self-custody XNO rail that no other framework offers. It reuses the x402nano-exact scheme and the 402nano.org facilitator, and rebuilds none of them.
